dataset: research/45_market_dataset, root-owned shared manifest and account engine
selection: validation net simulated-account PnL at 2 bps extra adverse cost per leg; lexicographic candidate-ID tie break; no-trade is eligible
selection_groups: one momentum candidate, one ridge threshold, one boosting threshold per horizon; nine separate frozen policies
model_training: train-only models and scaling; no refit after validation; no test tuning
label: decision after completed minute t; one full-minute reaction delay; entry at open t+2 and exit at open t+2+h; simple gross return bps
threshold_semantics: net forecast margin after decision-time estimated round-trip fees and two adverse-cost legs; account helper performs gating
limitations: Universe consists of current locally available stocks; historical membership unverified
Candle reference fills and fee sensitivity do not verify depth, real spread, margin or shortability
Validation-selected policies are one bounded study and remain subject to selection bias
Test history is locally available data, not guaranteed pristine
